semantics.completePrograms: sum of unique complete programs per route; duplicates across routes count again
semantics.limits: observed work under declared caps, not full feasible enumeration
semantics.warmup: Java helper startup/one sample compile excluded; worker startup included
semantics.prescribed: geometry points only; no authored timings or facing seeds in timed arms
semantics.solverCalls: calls to standalone.ipopt.solve, including outer retries; not internal IPOPT phases or iterations
